patterns.description: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
Several reviews indicate that customers find the pricing to be too high or not offering good value.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation, use of lower quality ingredients, or lack of attention to detail in the kitchen.

root_causes.pattern: Several reviews indicate that customers find the pricing to be too high or not offering good value.
root_causes.cause: Pricing strategy not aligned with perceived value, or high operational costs being passed onto the customer.

root_causes.pattern: A recurring pattern of unspecified negative experiences categorized as 'other', suggesting issues not fitting into standard categories.
